It was often given to children born into royal families or those with significant potential to achieve greatness in their communities. The name carries a sense of pride and respect that is deeply ingrained in the cultural identity of the Yoruba people.

The phrase "God is my treasure" conveys a sense of trust, devotion, and reliance on the divine. For those who bear this name, it serves as a constant reminder to seek God's guidance and wisdom in all aspects of life. It is a name that inspires individuals to live their lives with purpose, integrity, and faith.
